svg.text: J3 of the ESP32-BOBOARD-5V to the cartridge slot (~CCTL, bus) and the ECI (~D1XX)
number in the circle = J3 pin
number in the circle = J3 pin
Pinouts checked against atarimania.com (Atari 8-bit FAQ) and computersmuseum.com (130XE).
800XL: the PBI connector carries no ~D1XX; $D1xx must be decoded from A8-A15 (external logic, not shown).
Never connect J3 26 (EN) and 27-28 (+3V3). Program the ESP32 only disconnected from the computer.
